$comment: First-load JS per route, gzip, in KB (docs/features/00 §6.3). `maxGzipKB` is the enforced ratchet; `targetGzipKB` is the product budget it must reach. Round 4 (2026-10-01) measured 193.1 KB (Home) and 230.1 KB (Practice Hub) after lazy supabase-js, LazyMotion and a lazy theme menu (from 282.1 and 318.9), so the ratchet is current + 5 %. Lower maxGzipKB whenever a change makes the bundle smaller; never raise it to make a build pass.
